Isme ownership goods ki badalti hai, producer se lekar consumer tak. Trade production nahi karta, sirf distribution karta hai. Commerce (वाणिज्य): Commerce ek broader term hai jo trade ke saath-saath un sab activities ko cover karti hai jo goods ko producer se consumer tak pahunchane mein help karti hain.
